title: Four A-A pairs at r0 = 1.0 through contact: what the simulator does after the singular pair-law collision
pitch: The published A-A pair law is singular at separation 0 and has no contact model. Released at rest from r0 = 1.0, a pair reaches separation 0.5 at t = 0.19 and collapses near t = 0.23 (pre-registered). Four A-A pairs give four replicate contacts in one run. Pre-contact falsifier: the unclamped P-0026 law predicts all four pairs, up to the first tracker separation below 0.5, to RMSE/L 0.02 or better. Post-contact behaviour is measured, not predicted: pass-through, bounce, or sticking. Cost 1.32 credits.
